source.description:
She is in love with her sister [Akane Hiyama](https://anilist.co/character/122435/Hiyama-Akane).

The school's idol who [Seiji](https://anilist.co/character/122437/Aino-Seiji) is in love with, she turns out to be a yandere. Although they have different surnames, she's also the older sister of [Yuzu Kichougasaki](https://anilist.co/character/122433/Kichougasaki-Yuzu).

An Angel/Cupid. She often treats her duty as a Cupid like a joke, forming almost exclusively gay couples due to her love for male romance.

Seiji is a more-or-less level headed individual, trying to please all the women around him without hurting them. He is a high school student and older brother of [Akua Aino](https://anilist.co/character/122432/Aino-Akua).
The sadistic, hollow, and manipulative cousin of [Akane](https://anilist.co/character/122435/Hiyama-Akane) and [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/122433/Kichougasaki-Yuzu).
Seiji's tomboyish younger sister.
He is Yuzu's personal attendant and chauffeur assigned to her by her mother, Ameisha.

source.description: Komura is a shy, good-natured middle-school boy. He has had a crush on Mie since the first days of school, but because of his fear of being rejected, it is difficult for him to confess his love to her. He loves playing games, especially those at the arcade.

An absentminded and innocent middle-school girl who sits next to Komura-kun. She has poor eyesight and must wear glasses, but she tends to forget them quite often. 
Whenever Mie forgets her glasses her depth perception in particular suffers and thus she tends to lean in close to Komura-kun.
Mie's friend and classmate.
Mie's friend and classmate.

__Height__: 163 cm  

A second-year at Mihama Academy, and the daughter of the East Beach Railway Express Group tycoon. She was the first student to enroll at Mihama Academy. She has waist-length black hair. Because of her bluntness and hard-to-please personality, she has difficulty talking to others. Always trying to be alone, she hardly spends time with the others. She always carries a box cutter with her and use it to threaten others when she’s angry. She is a bookworm, and mystery novels are her favorite genre. Although she gives off the aura of a spoiled princess, she loves junk foods, and a cup of fried soba noodles is her favorite meal.  Her representative fruit is grape.

__Height:__ 178 cm

The protagonist of Grisaia. Ace number 9029, Yuuji is the “janitor” for the underworld. Tired of the life, he wanted to live a normal school life. Cool, philosophical, and minimalist, Yuuji is a realist…but also tsundere. Being very cowardly, he always plans and scouts before action. Other than his occasional orthodontic military methods, he’s just a fit young man.

__Height:__ 144 cm

First-year student at Mihama Academy, an innocent and carefree girl. For some inexplicable reasons, it’s hard to understand her personality. In general, she can be explained in one word, “fool”, but sometime her speeches and behaviors make people shed cold sweat. For that uniqueness, most of people who talk with her for five minutes will say, “This girl is awful”. She adores Yuuji like a brother and Amane like a sister. She calls Yuuji “onii-chan”. Although she has her own room in the dormitory, she always stays in Amane’s room. She always wears knee-socks with 2 different colors. Because of her parents' work, she stayed in foreign countries until she was six so she can speak English. Her representative fruit is strawberry in the visual novel, and apple in the anime.

__Height:__ 151 cm

First-year student at Mihama Academy and the maid of Mihama Academy. Except when going to school, taking a bath, or swimming, she always wears her maid uniform. The students at Mihama told her to wear maid uniform as much as possible as a joke, but she took it seriously. Polite and having strong sense of responsibility, she never fails to accomplish any request from others. In her action dictionary, there are only 3 words “receive” – “confirm” – “execute”. Because of that reason, sometimes she takes a joke too seriously and causes a lot of trouble. Her favorite animal is the shark. The shark-shaped pouch which [Michiru](https://anilist.co/character/80897/Matsushima-Michiru) carries around is made by her.

Her representative fruit is apple in the visual novel, and strawberry in the anime.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Second-year student at Mihama Academy, a fake tsundere with bleached blonde twintails. She has a deep interest in tsundere characters and tries to act like one. Her silly and energetic personality makes her becomes the mood maker of the class. Her grades are bad. She always carries a shark-shaped pouch which contains lemonade sweets. Despite having difficulty with sour foods, she still tries to drink 100% pure Vitamin C in order to “improve her intelligence”. She has encountered many instances of bad luck since her birth but always manages to get through them in one way or another.  Her representative fruit is the lemon.

__Height:__ 169 cm

Third-year student at Mihama Academy, she is the big sister type who always takes care of others. Because of unknown circumstances, she skipped one school year at her previous school, so she is actually two years older than [Yuuji](https://anilist.co/character/80891). She is tall and has a good figure. Her family manages a long-established restaurant in Ginza, so she is good at cooking. Because her mother comes from Kyoto, when excited or panicking, she talks in a Kansai dialect. She has a deep interest in cars and has acquired an automatic two-wheeled vehicle license. She has a dirt bike which was remodeled to a cruiser called “Boba Tarou” and is put in the garage of the academy.  Her representative fruit is cherry.

__Height:__ 150 cm

Kazuki is [Yuuji](https://anilist.co/character/80891)'s elder sister as well as the one who taught him throughout the earlier periods of his life.

Despite her delicate and diminutive body, she has brilliant intellect and excels in quick-witted judgement to the point that she has been labelled as a genius. She is the same age as [Amane](https://anilist.co/character/80899), both of which attended the same school "Takizono Private" and was also an active member of the basketball team for the aforementioned academy.
~!She unfortunately dies in an accident which has a great impact on both Amane's and Yuuji's lives, with the latter being more emotionally shaken.!~

__Height:__ 174 cm

Asako was Yuuji's former master. She took charge of raising Yuuji when his parents passed away. She was both harsh and sweet, capable and incompetent and drilled many of her own values into Yuuji. Thanks to her job of bringing him up, he can at least act normal, but now possesses a strong wariness for the horrors of large women. She also completely and utterly incompetent at cooking as she couldn't even make fried rice.

Asako wasn't particularly different from Yuuji; she loved to read. She was content to pass time with a book, a pack of cigarettes, and a pot of coffee especially on rainy days when she didn't have anything particular to do.

__Height:__ 157 cm

The only daughter of prefectural governor and the principal of Mihama academy. To her, Yuuji is a benefactor of life, as he rescued her in an event in the past. Because of that reason, when Yuuji told her that he wanted to have a normal school life, she offered him the chance to enroll to Mihama Academy. Sometimes, she is mistaken for a junior school girl due to her young figure. Her age is about 30 and she still a virgin. She has a habit of speaking quickly when telling a lie.

(Source: VNDB)

She is a black ops operative who happens to be Yuuji's guardian and handler. Her former name is Julia Bardera but she changed it after moving to Japan, that’s why Yuuji calls her JB. Though she looks American, she is a mixed blood between German and Italian.

An international terrorist who was an acquaintance of Yuuji's father, and took him after Yuuji killed his father. He trains Yuuji to be an assassin, and has him complete missions for him.

He is the main antagonist of Grisaia no Rakuen.

titles: 東京ゴッドファーザーズ

source.description: An alcoholic that once made money by racing bicycles. When his daughter became ill, he threw a race to get the money for her medicine, but because of that got banned from the sport.   ~!... or so he says , in reality he owned a bike shop with his wife , he ran up a gambling debt and ran away from home leaving his wife with the shop and the baby who became a nurse!~   After that he started living on the streets with Hana and Miyuki.

A homeless trans woman. She never knew her actual parents, and thus feels the most sympathy for "Kiyoko", the baby she finds and names. Because of her upbringing, she is the kindest out of the three main characters, but is also the sickliest, which she hides from the others.

Miyuki's backstory deals with her fear of returning home. She is a runaway girl who leaves home because she hated her father's over-controlling ways. In the past, Miyuki was slightly overweight, but after 6 months on the streets, she has lost a substantial amount of weight.

Miyuki considers herself to be a very independent young woman, however at her young age, she greatly relies on the support and safety that Hana and Gin provide for her in order to survive on the streets.
The little baby that Hana, Gin and Miyuki want to protect.

~!The self-proclaimed mother of Kiyoko. When Kiyoko is abandoned by her father, Sachiko falls into despair and prepares to commit suicide before Kiyoko is returned to her. In a strange turn of events, it is revealed that Kiyoko is not Sachiko's biological daughter.  !~
~!Gin's daughter, a nurse. She is on the verge of being married to the Doctor by the time she is rediscovered by Gin.!~  (Source: Wikipedia)
A former neighbor of Sachiko, which holds in the old ruined house of her cats. The house they visited therefore very regularly to feed the local cats.

As a doctor, he is a very able man, and because he treats everyone the same patient, he makes on others always a nice impression. His life has not been easy, as both his wife and his child he lost. Of which he has not let it get in Kiyoko and has now found a new love with which he is engaged. He also has a physical disability affecting his right leg.

After an argument with his daughter, he is severely injured by her with a knife, which he survived but. She runs off and no longer has the courage to return home, even though her ​​father is not angry at her, and she would love to go back in its vicinity.

As Miyuki, Hana and Gin have reached a dead end in their search for Sachiko, Kurumizawa tried to grab the trio with information on the ground. It ends, however, so that they and their neighbors a little gossip about the couple.
The proprietor of the gay bar Hana was formerly employed in.

Yasuo is Sachiko's husband, who has abandoned her and is currently in a dilapidated shack that can be aptly described as a dump, dwells. It all actually started very well, they loved each other, had a shared house and Sachiko was also pregnant. But then fell Yasuo gambling addiction, by which the marriage was suffering because he also took his wife's money in order to gamble on the tables. Even the alcohol he was not averse and when he was drunk again, it was no longer possible to talk reason with him.

**Height:** 178 cm (5'10'')

Hideki Motosuwa is a student who is attempting to qualify for university by studying at the Seki cram school in Tokyo. He's an honest and kind teenager who was raised on a farm, and unfortunately for him, has no experience with women. He has a very active imagination, which tends to result in him talking to himself in public. Hideki is interested in finding a girlfriend and has a great desire to have a Persocom—a computer shaped in the form of a human who can do all sorts of things. Although he cannot afford one, his luck holds out when he finds one lying in a garbage dump on his way home from the groceries, which he names [Chii](https://anilist.co/character/227/Chii).

__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

Chii is a Persocom who is found by [Hideki Motosuwa](https://anilist.co/character/225) in a garbage dump. At first, she is only able to say "Chii", thus earning her that name. Later on, she is taught various things, and is eventually able to communicate with other people.

~!She is a Chobit, a legendary Persocom that is capable of thinking independently and feeling human emotions. Her real name is Elda. She was created to be a "little sister" to Freya, the first Chobit, after Chitose Hibiya noticed Freya becoming increasingly sad. After Freya eventually breaks down, Elda takes Freya's mind into her own in an attempt to save her. In the manga, this causes her own memories to reset. In the anime, Hibiya resets Elda's memories in order to find the One just for her.  Chi has a special program installed on her designed to connect to every persocom on the planet. In the manga, if Chi fails to find the One just for her, she would delete the ability for persocoms to recognize humans from one another. In the anime, if Chi does find the One just for her, the program would give all persocoms the ability to feel real emotions.!~

Shinbo quickly becomes Hideki's best friend once Hideki moves into the same apartment complex as him. He is quite knowlegdable when it comes to Persocoms, which ends up in Hideki turning to him whenever he needs help with Chii. He has his own Persocom named Sumomo (Plum). He also attends to the same cram school as Hideki. 

~!He ends up being involved with his teacher, Takako Shimizu, when he finds her in a park after being locked out by her husband, who was too involved with his own Persocom.!~

Hibiya is the landlady at the apartment [Hideki](https://anilist.co/character/225/Motosuwa-Hideki) is living in. After Hideki finds [Chii](https://anilist.co/character/227/Chii), Hibiya helps him get clothes for Chii, and even teaches her how to use the baths.

Minoru is a wealthy twelve year old who specializes in Persocoms, and has built his own custom Persocom named Yuzuki, who is meant to be almost exactly like his late sister. He becomes one of Hideki's closest friends when he becomes interested in Chii's origins, and assists him whenever there's a problem. He is calm and collective most of the time, but this attitude tends to change whenever Yuzuki is around, and is prone to outbursts whenever she is in trouble, much like Hideki when Chii is in trouble. He is also a very forgiving character, always telling Yuzuki that it is not her fault whenever something goes wrong.

Kotoko is another laptop persocom, like Sumomo, but she was custom-built by Yoshiyuki and has much higher specifications than Sumomo.  ~!Kotoko originally belonged to Yoshiyuki, but following Chi's kidnapping, Hideki and Shinbo force Yoshiyuki to transfer ownership of Kotoko to Hideki so that her memories of Yoshiyuki kidnapping Chi cannot be erased.!~  Kotoko is far more serious than Sumomo, and thinks that everyone in the Motosuwa household is crazy, especially Sumomo, although she herself occasionally exhibits a sarcastic wit. Kotoko is programmed to always tell the truth, no matter what, even when it works to Yoshiyuki's disadvantage.

Sumomo is a mobile persocom - which is the persocom equivalent of a laptop computer. She is programmed to be cute and tends to be quite hyperactive, for example her morning 'wakey wakey exercises'.     At the beginning of the series, Shinbo uses Sumomo in an attempt to analyze Chi, and Sumomo is nearly broken in the process, requiring new main memory, and in the manga, a new video card as well. Once Kotoko joined Hideki, she quickly came to the conclusion that Sumomo was crazy, with her nonsensical ways. Sumomo's password after being received by Hideki is Chobits (case sensitive) and ちょびっツ　(case sensitive because of the katakana at the end)

Kojima is known as "Dragonfly" on online BBS boards, and like Minoru, is also a custom Persocom builder. His obsessions with Persocoms are shown when he kidnaps Chii in order to find out more about her origins after hearing about her on the BBS board where Minoru posted. He later makes amends for his actions by helping Hideki and Minoru find out more about Chii's origins and the Chobits.

Hiroyasu Ueda  is the owner of Chiroru, a local bakery which Yumi once worked in and which Chi ends up working at. He, too, has suffered a trauma involving persocoms.    ~!When he first opened his bakery, he bought a persocom to help with math and accounting, which he admits he is terrible at. He eventually fell in love with this persocom and then married her, but she developed a hard disk fault which resulted in the gradual degradation of her memory, until she remembered almost nothing at all.  Rarely, she would suddenly recall small fragments of memories from her life with Hiroyasu. He could not bring himself to have her repaired because her memories might be lost completely in the process of transferring them to a new hard drive, and he felt she would not be the same person if this happened. Soon, her memory degraded to the point that she could not remember anything for more than a few seconds at a time, and Hiroyasu had keep a constant watch on her to prevent her from wandering away. One night while walking with his persocom, Hiroyasu, lost in thought, walked into the middle of the street, unaware of an oncoming car. In one final moment of clarity, his persocom pushed him out of the way, and was herself run over. Her last words to Hiroyasu were, "Konnichiwa."!~   ~!Hiroyasu and Yumi Omura were in love in the past, but broke up when Yumi quit her job at the bakery when she discovered that the persocom he married was named "Yumi" and feared she would never live up to the other Yumi. Through the help of Chi and Hideki, he and Yumi resume their relationship.!~

Yumi Omura is a girl who works at the Japanese pub, My Pleasure, alongside Hideki. She is the daughter of the club's owner. It is initially implied that Yumi was interested in a relationship with Hideki, but as the series progresses it is revealed that she initially approached him because he also worked at Club Pleasure, and that she thinks of him as a big brother. Throughout most of the series Yumi has an inferiority complex toward persocoms, and becomes upset at any mention of a human-sized persocom.    ~!The reason for this is that while Yumi was working at Chiroru she fell in love with the manager, Hiroyasu Ueda. She gathered the courage to tell him, and found out that he reciprocated her feelings. All would have been well, except that Yumi discovered that Ueda had previously been married to a persocom that he had named Yumi, and she thought that he would compare the human Yumi to the persocom Yumi and find the human Yumi inferior.  However, Hideki eventually manages to persuade Yumi that Hiroyasu wouldn't have started anything if he didn't love Yumi for who she was, and he and Yumi start going out again.  !~

Yuzuki is a persocom created by Minoru Kokubunji roughly two years before the start of the series. Yuzuki was created to resemble, physically and mentally, Minoru's late sister, Kaede, who had died from an illness two years earlier. Yuzuki was programmed with all of the data that Minoru could remember about his sister; what she liked, what she disliked, her habits and behaviors�everything. However, Minoru still realizes that no matter how realistic she may be, she is still only a persocom that is following her programming. Yuzuki, despite not having the same processing capacity as a persocom like Chi, also seems to possess an awareness of her own limitations.
Takako Shimizu is Hideki and Shinbo's teacher at the Seki cram school.

Jima one of two government persocoms who are looking for Chii. They do not want her to execute her final program, which they believe would destroy the person-recognition abilities of every persocom on the planet. It is believed that the program will execute when Chii finds the person just for her. Jima, however, believes that this may not necessarily be true, and genuinely wants Chii to find happiness. He lies to Dita about Chii's whereabouts and stalls as long as possible before finally going to stop her. In the manga, Jima physically restrains Dita from attacking Chii. Jima is also the Japanese government's national data bank, and during the course of the series an attempt is made by Yuzuki to hack into him to gain information on Chii. In the anime, Jima remarks that he and Dita were created from the same basic system that Chii is, rendering them immune to her ability to immobilize persocoms.

Dita is the second of the two persocoms looking for Chii. Her role is to protect Jima both physically and as a pro-active firewall, hacking into any persocom who tries to hack into Jima and shutting it down (which happens to Yuzuki during her attempt to hack Jima). Dita appears to love Jima, but tries to deny it, believing the persocoms cannot or should not experience such feelings.
Atashi is a strange creature resembling a rabbit who is the main character of Chi's favorite book series "A City With no People."    ~!In the series, Atashi represents Chii.!~

~!Freya was one of the two Persocoms that were part of a series of Persocoms known as "CHOBITS". She was created because the wife of Ichiro Mihara (the inventor of the Persocoms), Chitose Hibiya, was unable to bear children. All was fine, until poor Freya fell in love with Ichiro. Freya eventually broke from the strain on her circuits. Before she "died", however, she transferred her memories into her younger sister (the other persocom in the "CHOBITS" series), Elda (also known as "Chii"), so that Freya would be able to protect her "sister". Freya is the mysterious Persocom that Chii sees when she closes her eyes.!~

Anata is a strange creature resembling a rabbit, similar to Atashi, who is the supporting character of Chi's favorite book series "A City With no People."    ~!In the series, Anata represents Freya.!~

Ueda's persocom. Ueda originally bought her because he was not so good with math.  ~!As time passed he fell in love with her and decided to marry her. However soon after marriage she started to forget customer orders, and even forgot Mr. Ueda's name. It was later discovered to be cause by a hard disk failure. He could not bring himself to have her repaired because her memories might be lost completely in the process of transferring them to a new hard drive, and he felt she would not be the same person if this happened.   One night while walking with his persocom, Ueda, lost in thought, walked into the middle of the street, unaware of an oncoming truck. In a final moment of clarity, his persocom pushed him out of the way and was herself run over. Her last word to Ueda was "Konnichiwa"; the default greeting for a newly activated persocom with no memories.!~

source.description:
A mysterious woman who fell from the sky. She, by all means, wants to reach the northern land called Helheim.

Amira is a very tall young woman with pale skin, violet eyes, and long, flowing, pink hair she ties in two ponytails. Her attire is somewhat unusual, consisting of a white blouse with a black vest above it, and a knee-length tan-colored shirt which acts as a coat, with a maroon and red vest covering her shoulders. She wears white and beige shorts, held up with a black belt, and two long, cowboy-looking boots with folded top edge, patched black in color.

Favaro makes his living as a bounty hunter. He can't live without women, money and wine. His life takes a turn when he meets [Amira](https://anilist.co/character/88554/Amira).

Favaro is a young man with an orange hair styled into an afro, and green eyes. He has a large X-shaped scar on his face. His armor consists of a left pauldron, plate on his left elbow, plates on both of his knees and plated boots.

Speaks with a carefree attitude and is somewhat of a self-proclaimed ladies' man. He doesn't like to be responsible for others and claims that he only watches out for himself.

characters.name: Kaisar Lidfard
nicknames: カイザル・リドファルド

source.name_native: カイザル・リドファルド
source.description:
Kaisar used to be a knight from a prestigious family, but has since become a bounty hunter. He chases Favaro, blaming him for his current status.

Kaisar is a very tall man, with white pants, a green shirt with white stripes and golden buttons, and a dark green vest hung over it, with green arm covers and golden stripes on the wrists. He has his knight's sword sheathed in a navy blue scabbard on his left side at all times. At times he's seen in gray knight's armor; even when he takes the armor off he keeps the leggins of the armor on his legs. Can be often seen holding a knight's pose and usually bears himself with knightly demeanor.

He is a righteous man with a very strong sense of honor, and constantly follows his own ideal of justice. Kaisar is shown to be very empathetic and compassionate, as seen during his meeting with Rita. Because of his tragic past as a rebellious son who was distant from his family, Kaisar now highly values family and abhors other people who take their family for granted. Seems to have a crush on Amira, calling her a beauty on their first encounter.

Rita is a young child who lives in Nebelville, and is the daughter of the village doctor. She has short black hair and bangs, and usually wears a lopsided hat. She has somewhat of a quiet and timid personality.

~!She is actually a young necromancer. One day a monster invaded the village and killed everyone, leaving her as the only survivor of the massacre. Alone and scared, Rita used the Black Bible to revive her parents and the dead villagers, and concealed all of them behind an magical mist that made the zombies look as if they were alive. For two hundred years she lived with the zombified remnants of the town until she was, in the end, bitten by her own parents. After being spared by Kaisar and becoming an undead, she now follows the former knight in his travels.!~

Lavalley is a member of the Orleand Knights, serving under captain Jeanne d'Arc.  He is a tall man with dark skin, a black shirt, and a vest covering it which is a combination of maroon and brown, black pants, and tan leggings covering most of his legs and all of his feet. Has long, brown hair with a wide-looking mullet in the back, red eyes, and a small mustache.

Bacchus is the god that alongside Hamsa is in charge of giving the rewards to the bounty hunters after they have done their job. He is periodically drunk and his love for wine defines his personality. Doesn't tend to get involved in major events unless pushed.

A very tall, black man with a perky red nose and gray hair which is long on the back, and stretches to a beard around his chin tied in a ponytail with a golden tie, and the top of his head is bald.  Wears a long, thick, dark brown overcoat with light brown fur around the top edge and a brown shirt under it and turquoise pants and  large, brown shoes. He is always seen carrying a long, thick, brown staff with a silver top, which he often uses for fighting.

He nicknames Favaro as "Bomber Head", due to his afro.

Jeanne d'Arc is a captain of the Orleans Knights. She is a strong, fearless, and honorable warrior.

She is a fairly tall, blonde woman with magenta eyes and fair skin. Most of her long hair is pulled back into a tail, leaving locks of hair on either side of her face and straight-cut bangs free. She is most frequently seen in plate-armor. The armor is white with red accents and consists of an asymmetrical breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, a skirt, and boots. The breastplate appears to belted into place over dark teal and brown cloth. Underneath the plating, she wears a long-sleeved top and gloves in dark red and striped maroon leggings
He is the fallen angel since he dared to disobey the God himself. He now tries to get hold of the God's key.
Cerberus is the Guard Dog of Hades. She accompanies Azazel on his quest to find out who is behind the theft of the God Key.

Hamsa is the reincarnation of a god that inexplicably has taken the appearance of a duck. Alongside Bacchus he is in charge of guiding the bounty hunters in their job.

Hamsa looks like a normal duck with blue eyes. He wears a small golden crown. Shares with Bacchus a passion for alcohol, but he is considerably more focused and less likely to laze around, and is often seen reprimanding him.

Lucifer is a very powerful demon and the highest ranking fallen angel.

His impressive appearance bears traits of his former heritage, in the form of light which emanates from him. As a former Seraphim, he has three pairs of wings, one of which is darkened. His hair is silver, but his complexion is not as pale as Azazel's, with orange lips and eye shadow. A pair of bull-like horns adorn his head.
His attire consists of a decorative golden armor with a partially exposed chest, golden boots and skirt-like cloth wrapped around his waist.

Belzebuth is a very powerful demon. Cruel and ruthless, he is even willing to sacrifice his own daughter to further his goals.

Belzebuth is an extremely tall and muscular individual, with blood red skin, black scales starting at the elbows of his arms and reaching all the way to the tips of his fingers. Numerous long, jagged, curved, blacked horns protrude from his body and a gigantic, thick, gray scale is tied around his waist. Two blue stripes cross his face, and his black hair with the form of horns has a patch of white hair on the top of his head, sticking upward. 

He always carries a long, thin, black staff, with a wide, thick, long, blue tip on the top of it.
A knight from the Orleans Knights tasked with retrieving the stolen God Key from Amira.

source.description: Toujou Basara is an ex-member of the Hero-clan. He lives with his two step sisters who are both Demons. Basara is determined no matter what to protect [Naruse](https://anilist.co/character/89158/Naruse-Mio) from anyone wanting to cause harm to her.

__Height:__ 156 cm

Mio is a beautiful young girl of average height, with long waist-length red hair and violet eyes. She is noted for having a distinctly voluptuous body for someone her age. Mio has been seen wearing a number of outfits throughout the series, with several casual attires at home that are usually form-fitting or revealing, as well as a uniform for attending school. After forming a contract with [Basara](https://anilist.co/character/89157/Toujou-Basara), Mio gains a choker-like tattoo around her throat which takes the appearance of a love heart with two prongs extending around either side of her neck.

Mio normally displays a calm demeanor, preferring to remain quiet when around others; however, she is prone to outbursts when faced with inappropriate situations such as finding erotic magazines underneath Basara's bed or being left at the mercy of [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/89160/Naruse-Maria)'s succubus curse. Despite this, she is also caring and affectionate, genuinely appreciate Basara's kind treatment and protection as well as feeling uncomfortable about having to deceive innocent people. Deep down she is afraid of her current situation and constantly being under threat, but when faced with danger she won't hesitate to face the challenge.

voice_actors.name: ブリドカット・セーラ・恵美

Maria is Mio's sister and guardian.

She is a rather childish person and likes teasing people no matter how serious the situation is. Despite this, she can be dead serious as seen when she revealed her real identity to Basara.

A Hero and the sister of [Yuki Nonaka](https://anilist.co/character/89159/Nonaka-Yuki). She is also an Element Master.

Kurumi is a petite, young girl who is surprisingly developed for her age. She has blue violet hair held up in a ponytail by a white scrunchy and yellow eyes like her sister. Her battle outfit tightly wraps around her slim figure and is the typical attire for female Heroes which is a navy blue leotard with a black collar and a white skirt. Kurumi chooses to wear short tights underneath and her limbs are covered by her Spirit Armor with her Spirit Gauntlet on her left hand.
Zest is a Demon who originally served her creator, the Demon marquis Zolgear, as his aide.

He poses as a student of Hijirigasaka Academy and serves as Mio's observer. He is also known as the Demon Lord Lars

A young girl who was left to die alone in the old school building of Seikyou Private Academy long ago. She has no recollection of how she died and is currently searching for clues together with [Teiichi Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi). As a ghost, she is normally invisible to the people in the school, with the exceptions of Teiichi and [Kirie Kanoe](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie), a blood relative who can also see her.

Apparently, she has grown fond of Teiichi and has expressed her desire to be by his side forever.   Except for Teiichi, the other members are unaware that Yuuko is actually the 'absentee' president of the Paranormal Investigations Club.   Meanwhile, the surname "Kanoe" is derived from the 7th sign of the Chinese calendar, which originally meant "evening star" and also means "a person's age".

In the anime series, Yuuko is attributed to autumn leaves and the sky during sunset, which both share the same fiery hues. "

Teiichi is a pupil in the school [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko) died about 50 years ago, he once heard rumors about a spirit in the school who was left to die alone. Teiichi is able to see her and wants to help Yuuko to find out why she died.

In her first appearance, she warns [Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi) about [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko).

~!Kirie is the only other character who can see Yuuko. She is a member of Yuuko’s family and looks exactly like Yuuko except for her short hair, ear piercings, and smaller breasts (much to her resentment).  She later joins as one of the three members of the paranormal investigations club.  The other members, Niiya and [Momoe](https://anilist.co/character/42926/Okonogi-Momoe), seem to be her closest friends. Even after joining the club she remains apprehensive of Yuuko, but accepts Niiya's judgment.!~

The most enthusiastic member of the Paranormal Investigations Club, Momoe is a year older than [Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi) and begins to develop feelings for him after seeing his dedication to solving the Seven Mysteries. Like most people, she is not able to see [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko).

Momoe also becomes close friends with [Kirie](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie) by the time of the school festival. Officially, Momoe is a member of the school's Third Newspaper Club, but she is able to participate in the activities of both clubs due to the unofficial nature of the Paranormal Investigations Club.

She is also someone who easily believes in any urban legend she comes across.
A second year student who shares the same first name with the ghost in the school's stories. Because of this, she becomes the target of unwanted attention from the other students around her.
Yukariko is [Kirie](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie)'s grandmother and one of the school directors. She is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko)'s younger sister.

titles: Ore wa Subete wo [Parry] Suru: Gyaku Kanchigai no Sekai Saikyou wa Boukensha ni Naritai
俺は全てを【パリイ】する ～逆勘違いの世界最強は冒険者になりたい～
I Parry Everything: What Do You Mean I'm the Strongest? I'm Not Even an Adventurer Yet!
I Parry Everything to Become the Greatest Adventure!

source.description:
Though he aspired to become an adventurer, at the age of twelve he was deemed to possess "absolutely no talent whatsoever in anything." Yet, refusing to abandon his dream, he secluded himself in the mountains to hone his "Parry" skill—a dedication that eventually allowed him to grow capable of deflecting a thousand blades. 
~!
In truth, he possesses truly extraordinary abilities, though he remains the only one completely oblivious to them.!~

He is currently registered with the guild at the lowest possible rank, he spends his days simply performing menial chores around the town.

characters.name: Lynne
nicknames: Linneburg Clays (リンネブルグ・クレイス)

name_alternative: Linneburg Clays (リンネブルグ・クレイス)
source.description:
The First Princess of the Kingdom of Clays, her full name is Linneburg Clays. She excels in every conceivable ability, having graduated from the Royal Capital Training Academy with the highest scores in its history across all disciplines. She has comprehensively mastered skills spanning all six elemental systems. 

She was once attacked by a monster and saved from a perilous situation by [Noor](https://anilist.co/character/213554/Noor); ever since, she has looked up to him and affectionately addresses him as Sensei.
He is the First Prince of the Kingdom of Clays; his full name is Rein Clays. Possessing a calm and composed demeanor, he also serves as an aide to the King of Clays.

One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. He has been bestowed the title of "Magic Saint"—the highest rank attainable by a Mage—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Mage in the Royal Capital.

One of the Six Sovereigns who serve as guardians of the Kingdom of Clays. He has been bestowed the title of "Sword Saint"—the highest rank attainable by a swordsman—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Swordsmen in the Royal Capital.

A knight of the Kingdom of Clays and deputy commander of the Warrior Corps. She possesses a special defensive ability known as the “Divine Shield,” which she uses to serve as [Lynne's](https://anilist.co/character/330746/Lynne) bodyguard. 

A former orphan, she was taken in by the “Shield Saint” [Dandalg](https://anilist.co/character/330747/Dandalg), who taught her how to wield her power.

One of the Six Sovereigns who serve as guardians of the Kingdom of Clays. He holds the title of "Shield Saint"—the highest distinction attainable by a Warrior—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Warrior in the Royal Capital. 

He is [Ines's](https://anilist.co/character/330745/Ines-Harness) adoptive father; having taken her in from an orphanage, he taught her how to harness her powers.

One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. He has been bestowed the title of "Healing Saint"—the highest rank attainable by a Cleric—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Cleric in the Royal Capital.

One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. He holds the title of "Hidden Saint"—the highest rank among Thieves—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Thief in the Royal Capital.

One of the Six Sovereigns who safeguard the Kingdom of Clays. She has been bestowed the title of "Bow Saint"—the highest rank among Rangers—and also serves as an instructor at the School of the Ranger in the Royal Capital.

He is the King of the Kingdom of Clays—the nation that houses the world's oldest labyrinth, the "Labyrinth of No Return"—and the father of [Lynne](https://anilist.co/character/330746/Lynne) and [Rein](https://anilist.co/character/330742/Rein). In his days as an adventurer, he explored the "Labyrinth of the Lost" alongside the Six Sovereigns, ultimately discovering the Black Blade deep within its innermost depths. 

Although he has since retired from adventuring, he remains one of the kingdom's most formidable assets; having sensed the ominous atmosphere now shrouding the nation, he remains on high alert.

A kind-hearted boy with the special ability to communicate freely with monsters. He is a descendant of the demon race, considered an abhorrent existence that has long since gone extinct, and spent a very unhappy childhood working for a slave trader.

He serves as the Vice-Commander of the Spearman Corps—the guardians of the Kingdom of Clays—and bears the title of "Spear Saint." Possessing an unrivaled passion for battle, he once traveled far and wide in search of worthy opponents. He is a disciple of [Sig](https://anilist.co/character/330744/Sig), the "Sword Saint," and wields a spear.

**Height:** 179 cm

~!Due to her chronic memory loss, she forgets about everyone who she has communicated to (with some exceptions, like her parents, for example). This results in Yuuki wanting to befriend her, as to make her more generally happy and more extroverted, even forbearing the fact that her memories will disappear.!~

Yuuki Hase is a high school student who notices that his classmate [Kaori Fujimiya](https://anilist.co/character/88037/Fujimiya-Kaori) is always alone. He endeavors to be her friend even after learning that she loses every memory of her friends each Monday.

Hase's easily seen trait throughout the whole series is his apprehensiveness. Instances in the media have depicted Hase is hesitant and almost fearful of moving forward and taking the first step. He is also quite simple-minded, as he can be pleased and displeased by very seemingly minor details. However, he is very headstrong and bold when he finally comes to a decision, and will not rest until he has seen his decision through.

Hase can get easily jealous and mindful of certain things, such as the instance when Kaori talked about [Shougo](https://anilist.co/character/88162/Kiryuu-Shougo) so much that Hase was beginning to get jealous. In this regard, Hase is naive and impulsive, often acting before thinking when he is aggravated. He also sometimes jumps to conclusions, further worsening the situations he gets himself in.

However, Hase is kind by nature, and likes to socialize with people as a normal high-schooler would. He treats everyone with an equal amount of respect and kindness, save for people he has gotten to know better (except in the case of [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/88270/Kujou-Hajime), they aren't quite friends.) He tries to be considerate and polite as much as possible, though there are instances where his emotions can get the better of him and this doesn't turn out so well.
Kaori's mother. She's really kindhearted.

Hajime is a transfer student during the second semester who is Kaori's primary school classmate. He and Kaori promised to meet in the park the day before he transferred to Hokkaido, to which Kaori never fulfilled due to her accident. His family has strict demands on him, to the point where he isn't allowed to buy games.

Hajime is first shown as a very friendly person the day he transfers into his new school, however he rather acts very cold and distant towards Kaori. He calls her a "traitor" every single time due to the unfulfilled promise Kaori had on him, yet he doesn't tell her the truth until much more later.
Ai is Saki's friend who is a good coordinator.
Maiko is Saki's friend who often spoils her.

Saki is a clumsy and forgetful girl in their class who used to be Shougo's primary school classmate. She used to be bullied due to her small stature in primary school, and has since depended on others for all matters.

(Source: Wikipedia)
